dependency_coverage.name: ite
dependency_coverage.meaning: A conditional expression selecting its first value when a proposition holds and its second value otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the two zero-or-one coefficients according to t ≤ x and x < t.

conclusions: x = x · (if t ≤ x then 1 else 0) + x · (if x < t then 1 else 0).
mathematical_definitions: The first conditional coefficient is 1 when t ≤ x and 0 otherwise.
The second conditional coefficient is 1 when x < t and 0 otherwise.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every pair of real numbers x and t, x decomposes into the sum of x selected by the case t ≤ x and x selected by the complementary case x < t.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The proposition is restricted to real-valued x and t.
There are no hypotheses, so the assertion applies to every pair of real numbers.
The conditions t ≤ x and x < t are complementary in the real order, so exactly one conditional coefficient is 1 and the other is 0.
The statement is not vacuous because its universally quantified domain is nonempty and it asserts a concrete equality for all inputs.
